fpm01.finding: IRRIGATION is priority 2 and waits for shared baseline plus hydraulic view; source-bound oracle SHA-256 is 65830c1e030be8030995547729d9298e6352778f132e5195af2962baa38a3bf1.

fsi10.finding: Precomputed qssdi is admitted through the B1.10 source/sink provider; full production irrigation module reentrancy is explicitly outside F-SI10 scope.

fsi15_latest_completed_ownerlineage_chec.head: fe5e55d5d5ebff42e8212cba8df15652e5f1a52b
fsi15_latest_completed_ownerlineage_chec.finding: The common solver contract exposes soil_water_physical_state_t and solver evaluation providers, but no qualified process-facing hydraulic view or process hydraulic read interface is present. The physical-state carrier is a solver request/result type, not an admitted irrigation-facing contract.

fkt08.finding: Opaque checkpoint/candidate/commit transaction semantics and accepted-only authoritative full-interval mass accounting are qualified; the composed candidate contains the same kernel transaction blob.

decisive_runtime_hydraulic_reads: watcon(node,h(node)) across root-zone nodes for TCS2/TCS3/TCS4 and DCS1 water-deficit logic
decisive_state_mutations: nirri advances when a fixed event is consumed
dayfix advances/resets for weekly and minimum-interval scheduling
irrigevent and event-rate/duration fields change around active events
decisive_time_semantics: Irrigation(3) is invoked at legacy flDayStart
fixed-event matching uses calendar date t1900
weekly/minimum interval rules count daily process calls
event duration is represented as a fraction of a day and fixed-input durations greater than one day are rejected

gate_results.evidence: F-VQ17 and F-MQ24 both bind their qualification to exact candidate ffab7d705928170db3e76a5d346caafeb560e605 and tree 06bd92b2cf96b7bc6eb6978250017cd054547a56.
Live project archive irrigation.f90 SHA-256 equals the F-PM01 source-bound pin.

B1.10 irrigation requires committed h/theta semantics. The composed candidate has no process hydraulic-view module; latest completed F-SI15 common interfaces still only expose solver-facing state/request/result and evaluation-provider types. Direct use of reference_richards_state_binding_t or HeadCalc arrays would violate the process isolation invariant.
F-SI10 and the composed source/sink provider admit precomputed subsurface irrigation source qssdi into the solver source term.

F-KT opaque physical-state cloning, checkpoint, candidate, rollback and commit are qualified and present on the composed candidate. An irrigation implementation must place only continuation-critical management state inside that carrier and prove rollback/replay in F-PM tests.
No production irrigation state was added because the hydraulic-view gate failed first.
F-KT08 accepted-only mass is qualified. The F-MR06 backend counts accepted positive qssdi once as external inflow and counts accepted top-boundary flux once.
No migrated irrigation result exists to qualify; process reporting must remain non-authoritative and must not duplicate solver/runtime mass.

Parameter and fixed-event parsing can be translated into immutable parameters and management requests outside the kernel; no reason was found to retain file units or paths in a future irrigation process module.
Calendar schedules and day-count rules are explicit, while the legacy flDayStart invocation is identified as a caller assumption that must not be hidden in a generic kernel interval.
F-PM03 branch starts from exact qualified F-MR06 source candidate and makes no SNOW source or qualification change.

primary_blocker.required_owner_change: Define and qualify a small read-only process-facing hydraulic view, independent of reference-Richards/HeadCalc internals, with source-bound committed pressure-head and water-content semantics sufficient for irrigation TCS2/TCS3/TCS4/TCS7/TCS8 and DCS1 decisions.
minimum_release_evidence: committed-state mapping for pressure_head and water_content is explicit
sensor/root-zone indexing semantics are explicit or supplied separately as immutable geometry/mapping parameters
B1.10-equivalent h/theta observations are characterized and qualified

secondary_composition_owner.required_after_fsi_release: Compose the qualified hydraulic view onto the exact physical runtime lineage without blind merging, then expose the committed view to the process before irrigation decision evaluation.

fkt_followup_after_unblock: F-PM03 must prove irrigation-specific rollback/replay, fixed-event cursor protection, dayfix protection and exactly-once mass before structural qualification.
reason_tests_not_run: The readiness gate failed before production irrigation source existed; the requested inactive/event/A-B-A/rollback/mass/O0/O2/B1.10 migration suite applies only after readiness PASS and smallest-seam implementation.
next_allowed_step: Owner F-SI creates and qualifies the explicit process-facing hydraulic view. F-PM03 then re-enters from this exact blocker evidence and may implement the smallest irrigation seam only after the qualified view is source-bound onto an admitted runtime lineage.
